facts.business: Kkalpana Industries (India) Limited is engaged in the plastic processing industry, manufacturing plastic products including pipes, sheets, and other polymer-based items.
key_risks: Regulatory changes in plastic usage and recycling
Competition from unorganized sector and imports
facts.related_party_note: The company has related party transactions with entities including Kkalpana Plastick Limited, Kkalpana Industries Limited, and other promoter group companies. Transactions include purchase/sale of goods, rendering/receiving of services, and lease arrangements.
